pokedexEntries.x: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

pokedexEntries.or: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

pokedexEntries.y: It uses its tail to absorb electricity from power plants or from outlets in houses, and then it fires the electricity from its whiskers.

pokedexEntries.as: It uses its tail to absorb electricity from power plants or from outlets in houses, and then it fires the electricity from its whiskers.

pokedexEntries.us: It sneaks into people’s homes and steals electricity from their outlets. When your electric bill seems off, it’s the handiwork of this rascal.

pokedexEntries.um: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs that shoot electricity.

pokedexEntries.sw: A Dedenne’s whiskers pick up electrical waves other Dedenne send out. These Pokémon share locations of food or electricity with one another.

pokedexEntries.sh: Since Dedenne can’t generate much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.sc: It’s small and its electricity-generating organ is not fully developed, so it uses its tail to absorb electricity from people’s homes and charge itself.

pokedexEntries.vi: Dedenne emit electrical waves from the whiskers on their cheeks to communicate with each other. When low on electricity, they curl up and sleep.

pokedexEntries.za: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.
